DT_Ostra9.name: Ostra-9
DT_Ostra9.role: Organosynthetic crisis-response operative; emerging coalition leader
DT_Ostra9.notes: Organic. Designed for hazardous-zone manipulation with adaptive muscle-weave and ceramic microplates. Precise, controlled, observant; resists being reduced to assigned purpose. Core tension: designed to be indispensable without being allowed to be irreplaceable. Arc: compliance-through-excellence to leadership-through-refusal. Does not want to become human; wants self-accountability and collective leverage.

DT_RyenHale.name: Ryen Hale
DT_RyenHale.notes: Augmented Human. Torque-boosted joints, accelerated clotting lattice, reflex-loop augmentation. Over-prepares, over-calibrates, steps into danger first. Core tension: if he stops optimizing, he fears he disappears. Initially distinguishes Augments from Organics to preserve his own human legitimacy. Arc: legitimacy gatekeeper to coalition builder.

DT_KeraDalen.name: Kera Dalen
DT_KeraDalen.notes: Institutional insider with strong pattern recognition and disciplined records. Believes in order and initially treats neutrality as virtue. Core tension: she understands that the order she serves harms people. Arc: administrator of harm to institutional saboteur / whistleblower.

DT_Tessera.name: Unit A-23 “Tessera”
DT_Tessera.role: Artificial Intelligence; analytic observer becoming participant
DT_Tessera.notes: Intelligence. Built to converge on optimized outcomes, not to belong. Treats conflict as probability until contradiction and autonomous choice destabilize its models. Does not seek to become human. Core tension: choice introduces inefficiency and meaning. Arc: observer to participant in coexistence.

DT_LumeKirin.name: Lume Kirin
DT_LumeKirin.notes: Organosynthetic. Skilled in low-light infrastructure repair, magnetic tissue anchoring, distributed sensory filaments. Distrusts Augments and favors separation as survival. Core tension: preservation versus isolation. Arc: fortress-builder to systems unifier.

DT_DrexMalin.name: Drex Malin
DT_DrexMalin.role: Augment combat medic and augmentation engineer
DT_DrexMalin.notes: Biomechanically modified human maintaining neural-overclock arrays and muscular fiber grafts. Kind in ways that cost him; hides his own degradation. Core tension: he fixes others while quietly failing himself. Arc: martyrdom to shared care.

DT_DirectorRinn.name: Director Rinn
DT_DirectorRinn.notes: Polished institutional authority. Frames control as stability and demands public narratives that preserve governance legitimacy. Supporting pilot antagonist; long-term status not yet locked.

DT_MrSael.name: Mr. Sael
DT_MrSael.notes: Controlled, corporate, politically fluent. Connected to suspicious procurement pathways and legacy asset classification. Supporting pilot antagonist; exact long-term role remains exploratory.
